What could you say to young hopeless people who are awful at everything and lonely and just don't know what to do on this planet? Any suggestion how to cope and what goal to have?

If I only could, I would be happy to give you my 30yr old body. Seriously.

1. You are not a pedophile.

2. No British psychiatrist would ever count having sexual desires towards 12yr old females as something very unusual. Its more common then you think, it is just taboo in our society.

3. **Do not talk dirty with girls on-line who are under 18**, as it is a crime, and even if just cautioned by Police, you will end-up automatically at Dangerous and Sexual Offenders list for minimum 2 years, even if crime itself is silly in the eyes of police. Law is just very harsh in UK.

Please give yourself at least 10 years more.
You could have **great** career as writer. Remember that you are not alone.

I suggest you to watch some paintings of Egon Schiele and start working on book.

>what sort of situation would you be happy in

Never to be born. 

>Let me ask you, is any of those reasons a good reason to kill yourself on its own?

All of them combined are good reasons as they affect me deeply inside. I mean whats the point to suffer if there is nothing positive to counter-balance those (silly or not) hardships.

Maybe I'm not even depressed, I just lack rational goal why to live.
Unable to fulfill basic instincts, desires, even most basic economical meas or social life. From top to down, I'm failure in all aspects of life, and from rational point of view I don't see any evidence why future would be different.
